todo.note: ToggleSettingsRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, hint:, config:, accessory: .toggle(isOn))
ActionSettingsRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, role: isDestructive ? .destructive : .standard, config:, accessory: .action(action))
ActionRowLabel → UniversalRow(title, icon:, iconColor: tint, titleColor:, config:) with .contentShape(Rectangle())
NavigationSettingsRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, value:, config: .settings, accessory: .navigation { destination })
CheckmarkRow → UniversalRow(title, leadingIcon:, value:, config:, accessory: .checkmark(isSelected:action:))
MenuPickerRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, accessory: .menu(selection, options:)); a convenience init becomes an options list
NavigationPickerRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, config: .settings for .list, accessory: .picker(selection, options:))
DatePickerRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, accessory: .date(selection, components:, from:, through:))
StepperRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, accessory: .stepper(value, in:, step:, format:))
SliderRow → UniversalRow(title, icon:, hint:, config:, accessory: .slider(value, in:, step:, valueText:))
ColorPickerRow → UniversalRow(title, accessory: .colors(selection, palette:)); drop the padding around it
InfoRow → UniversalRow(label, icon:, config: .info, accessory: .info(value)) or .amount(amount, currency:, prefix:)
StatusIndicatorBadge(font:) → size: with an AppIconSize (md for the old default)
A component's symbol is an Icon(name, size: AppIconSize…, scalesWithText: false) (the 7.0 icon rule)
